articles.title: The Future as Propaganda: Soviet Architecture in Kazakhstan and the Imagery of a New Era
articles.summary: Practically every history book records 1961 as the year man first reached space , an achievement that placed the Soviet Union at the center of the space race . What not everyone knows is that Yuri Gagarin's journey began in a seemingly unlikely place, more precisely in Kazakhstan . From the Baikonur Cosmodrome , Gagarin set off beyond Earth, inaugurating not only a new era of space exploration but also a history of technology and ambition that would transform this landscape.

articles.title: From Colombia to New Markets: What La Feria De Diseño Medellín 2026 Left Behind
articles.summary: The 13th edition of La Feria De Diseño Medellín , powered by idd cologne, highlighted an evolution extending far beyond scale: over three days, Plaza Mayor brought together design, architecture, interior design, business, and knowledge on an increasingly international platform. Welcoming over 18,500 visitors and more than 22,000 participants across the city's broader ecosystem, the fair connected professionals, brands, and buyers around new ways of designing, specifying, and inhabiting spaces.

articles.title: House Beyond the Mango Trees / inLe architects
articles.summary: Located along a highway in Kannur , House Beyond the Mango Trees , designed by inLe architects, is shaped around two mature mango trees that stand near the centre of the site. Rather than removing them, the design allows them to become the organizing element of the house, informing movement, orientation, light, and privacy.

articles.title: Fengyuan Residence / Mao, Shen-Chiang Architecture Studio
articles.summary: Surrounded by neighboring buildings and city roads, the site offers few external views. Rather than seeking scenery outward, the design turns inward, creating a sheltered space of security, calm, and comfort, and bringing in a man-made nature, a "second nature" belonging to its residents.

articles.title: Hongling Middle School Shixia Campus / Tumushi Architects
articles.summary: Intervention of Hongling Middle School Shixia Campus: A Street-Life Community — In 2018, Shenzhen launched the "8+1 New Campus Initiative" to explore new models for schools in high-density urban environments. The intervention of Hongling Middle School Shixia Campus—founded in 2004—became the only expansion project completed in the plan's first phase, laying groundwork for the subsequent "100 Campus Renewal" initiatives.

articles.title: Collab Cafe & Concept Store / Levelstudio
articles.summary: Located in the heart of Central Asia, in Almaty , Kazakhstan, "Collab Cafe & Concept Store" repurposes the ground floor and basement of an old Soviet-era residential building into a welcoming, modern establishment that seamlessly combines a café and a concept store within a coherent environment.

articles.title: Baan Rim Bua House / VYN Studio
articles.summary: The design and construction concept of Baan Rim Bua, or a house beside a lotus pond, started with the owner's requirement to construct a single-story house with easy and simple maintenance, having a terrace for sitting with one's legs dangling while admiring the lotus pond, plus a semi-outdoor Thai kitchen for the use of family members and family reunions.

articles.title: Villa "San Isidro" / MACCCONSTRUCCIONES / APLUS
articles.summary: The design of this residence stems from an essential principle: the balance between its components. Its location in the middle of a forest, its orientation, and the views become the pillars that define its character. Villa San Isidro gathers all the elements of a contemporary house, but breaks with the traditional layout by inviting users to walk through the forest to reach the bedrooms. articles.title: Barrancos Mortuary / Mesa Atelier
articles.summary: In the development of the implantation area, between the upper level of the cemetery and the lower level of the centennial olive grove, allowing for the maintenance of the existing views system and fitting into the territory between traditional dry-stone walls, the Mortuary House of Barrancos is developed.

articles.title: ABC Apartment / agência campo espacial
articles.summary: The project was designed for a young couple in their first apartment, who were looking for a space that could accommodate the daily routine of people who cook and frequently host friends. Working with an area of 60m² and a limited budget, the strategy adopted was one of subtraction to reveal previously suppressed spatial qualities.

articles.title: Nature is "inseparable from daily life" at House K in Vietnam
articles.summary: Blocky volumes in exposed concrete contrast with the lush greenery and rooftop vegetable garden at House K, a home in Vietnam designed by local architecture studio HGAA.
